literal: That month Tian Qingxi, Administrator of Yan's east of the Mian, led seven commanderies, thirty-one counties, and ten thousand ninety households inward in submission.
idiomatic: That month Tian Qingxi, Xiao Yan's administrator east of the Mian, led seven commanderies, thirty-one counties, and ten thousand ninety households inward in submission.

literal: Ninth month, day jisi: Yuan Song, military inspector of Yangzhou, defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xiangzhou Yang Gongze and others and captured and beheaded several thousand.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, Yuan Song, military inspector of Yangzhou, defeated Yang Gongze, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xiangzhou, and others and captured and beheaded several thousand.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day wuchen, new moon: the king of Wuxing, Yang Shaoxian's uncle Jiqing plotted rebellion; an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendor Yang Chun to punish him.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the wuchen day, the new moon, Jiqing, uncle of Yang Shaoxian, king of Wuxing, plotted rebellion; an edict ordered Yang Chun, grand master of splendor, to punish him.

literal: Wang Zu besieged Fucheng; of garrisons in the Yi provinces twelve or thirteen surrendered, and the people sent household registers—more than fifty thousand households.
idiomatic: Wang Zu besieged Fucheng; of garrisons in the Yi provinces twelve or thirteen surrendered, and the people sent household registers—more than fifty thousand households.

literal: Soon after Zu withdrew his army.
idiomatic: Soon after Zu withdrew his army.

literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: again an edict ordered General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Huai to be cautious, [10] and sent him to punish the rebel Di of Wuxing.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengshen day, again an edict ordered Yuan Huai, general of agile cavalry, to be cautious [10] and sent him to punish the rebel Di of Wuxing.

literal: Third year, spring, first month, day dingmao, new moon: an imperial son was born; general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on the dingmao day, the new moon, an imperial son was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Day renshen: Xing Luan, military inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, repeatedly defeated the Di bandits and took Wuxing.
idiomatic: On the renshen day Xing Luan, military inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, repeatedly defeated the Di bandits and took Wuxing.

literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Ji province Huan He entered to raid South Qing province; the provincial army drove him off.
idiomatic: Xiao Yan's inspector of Ji province Huan He entered to raid South Qing province; the provincial army drove him off.

literal: The people of Qinzhou, Wang Fazhi and others, gathered a crowd of two thousand and styled themselves kings; soon they made Qinzhou registrar Lü Gou'er lord, era name Jianming.
idiomatic: The people of Qinzhou, Wang Fazhi and others, gathered a crowd of two thousand and styled themselves kings; soon they made Lü Gou'er, Qinzhou registrar, lord, with era name Jianming.

literal: Day jimao: Yang Jiqing and his brothers led one another in surrender.
idiomatic: On the jimao day Yang Jiqing and his brothers led one another in surrender.

literal: Second month, day bingchen: an edict said: "Of old Yu warned against fair words to the face while secret words are repeatedly offered;
idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingchen day, an edict said, "Of old Yu warned against fair words to the face while secret words are repeatedly offered;

literal: the Zhou officer charged with remonstrance was to admonish—where the king had gaps, he must needle them.
idiomatic: the Zhou officer charged with remonstrance was to admonish—where the king had gaps, he must needle them.

literal: We look up to continue the great foundation and bow to receive the imperial succession, thinking to bring peace to the myriad tasks, ten thousand affairs in a day—therefore we turn aside to await loyal words and emptyly seek straight counsel.
idiomatic: We look up to continue the great foundation and bow to receive the imperial succession, thinking to bring peace to the myriad tasks, ten thousand affairs in a day—therefore we turn aside to await loyal words and emptyly seek straight counsel.

literal: Yet good plans do not advance and schemes are unheard—can this be called harmonizing the chief, remedying what does not reach?"
idiomatic: Yet good plans do not advance and schemes are unheard—can this be called harmonizing the chief, remedying what does not reach?"

literal: Let dukes and princes and below be edicted: whoever has excellent plans and deep designs, frank words and loyal remonstrance, benefit to the state and convenience to the people, or correction of the age and sternness to custom—all are to point to the matter and memorialize; none may hedge.
idiomatic: Let dukes and princes and below be edicted: whoever has excellent plans and deep designs, frank words and loyal remonstrance, benefit to the state and convenience to the people, or correction of the age and sternness to custom—all are to point to the matter and memorialize; none may hedge.

literal: " Day wuwu: an edict ordered Right Guards General Yuan Li and others to punish Lü Gou'er.
idiomatic: " On the wuwu day an edict ordered Yuan Li, right guards general, and others to punish Lü Gou'er.

literal: Day yichou: General Who Pacifies the South Chen Bozhi defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xuzhou Chang Yizhi at Liangcheng.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Chen Bozhi, general who pacifies the south, defeated Chang Yizhi, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xuzhou, at Liangcheng.

literal: That month Xiao Yan's general Xiao Min led fifty thousand men to raid Huaiyang.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Min, Xiao Yan's general, led fifty thousand men to raid Huaiyang.

literal: Third month, day jisi: because the army was greatly raised, an edict halted all construction.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jisi day, because the army was greatly raised, an edict halted all construction.

literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered Inspector of Jing province Zhao Yi and General Who Pacifies the South Xi Kangsheng to go to Huaiyang.
idiomatic: On the jimao day an edict ordered Zhao Yi, inspector of Jing province, and Xi Kangsheng, general who pacifies the south, to go to Huaiyang.

literal: Prince of Lelang Zhangming was sentenced to death for killing a man; the state was abolished.
idiomatic: Zhangming, Prince of Lelang, was sentenced to death for killing a man; the state was abolished.

literal: Day wuzi: the imperial son was named Chang.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day the imperial son was named Chang.

literal: Day gengyin: General Who Pacifies the South, Marquis of Qujiang county, state founding, Chen Bozhi fled south from Liangcheng.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day Chen Bozhi, general who pacifies the south and Marquis of Qujiang county, state founding, fled south from Liangcheng.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day yiwei: [11] an edict abolished the salt-pond prohibition.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, [11] an edict abolished the salt-pond prohibition.

literal: Day jiachen: an edict dispatched envoys to tour and comfort chieftains and commoners of the northern frontier.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day an edict dispatched envoys to tour and comfort chieftains and commoners of the northern frontier.

literal: Day gengxu: Prince of Zhongshan Ying was made General Who Campaigns South and Area Commander of all military affairs on the Yang and Xu circuits, instructing frontier generals.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, was made general who campaigns south and area commander of all military affairs on the Yang and Xu circuits, instructing frontier generals.

literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Jiangzhou Wang Mao first raided Jing province and encamped at Henancheng; an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South Yang Dayan to punish him.
idiomatic: Wang Mao, Xiao Yan's inspector of Jiangzhou, first raided Jing province and encamped at Henancheng; an edict ordered Yang Dayan, general who pacifies the south, to punish him.

literal: Day xinyou: he greatly defeated them and beheaded his general who assists the state Wang Hua; heads and captives exceeded two thousand.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day he greatly defeated them and beheaded Wang Hua, general who assists the state; heads and captives exceeded two thousand.

literal: He advanced to attack Henancheng; Mao first fled in rout; pursuit ran to the Han River and took his five cities.
idiomatic: He advanced to attack Henancheng; Mao first fled in rout; pursuit ran to the Han River and took his five cities.

literal: General Yuwen Fu raided Xiao Yan's Si province, captured more than a thousand mouths, and returned.
idiomatic: General Yuwen Fu raided Xiao Yan's Si province, captured more than a thousand mouths, and returned.

literal: Fifth month, day yichou, new moon: an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to relieve the households newly attached at Yiyang.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yichou day, the new moon, an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to relieve the households newly attached at Yiyang.

literal: Day bingyin: an edict said: "Covering bones and burying flesh is an ancient statute; following the season to repair ordinances is the court's constant form.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict said, "Covering bones and burying flesh is an ancient statute; following the season to repair ordinances is the court's constant form.

literal: Now seasonal rain has not yet fallen and spring crops are already drought-stricken.
idiomatic: Now seasonal rain has not yet fallen and spring crops are already drought-stricken.

literal: Some solitary elderly starve or fall ill with no one to support them and thus die, exposed in ditches and moats—the Luoyang commandery captain shall bury them in coffins according to law.
idiomatic: Some solitary elderly starve or fall ill with no one to support them and thus die, exposed in ditches and moats—the Luoyang commandery captain shall bury them in coffins according to law.

literal: " Day renshen: Xiao Yan's general Zhang Huishao entered to raid and took Suyu.
idiomatic: " On the renshen day Zhang Huishao, Xiao Yan's general, entered to raid and took Suyu.

literal: Day yihai: Xiao Yan's general Xiao Rong took Liangcheng.
idiomatic: On the yihai day Xiao Rong, Xiao Yan's general, took Liangcheng.

literal: [12] Day xinsi: Xiao Yan's general Wei Rui took Hefei fortress.
idiomatic: [12] On the xinsi day Wei Rui, Xiao Yan's general, took Hefei fortress.

literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered Master of Writing Yuan Yao to lead troops south to punish.
idiomatic: On the renwu day an edict ordered Yuan Yao, master of writing, to lead troops south to punish.

literal: Day guiwei: because Qin and Long were not yet pacified, an edict ordered General Who Campaigns West Yu Jin to coordinate all armies.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day, because Qin and Long were not yet pacified, an edict ordered Yu Jin, general who campaigns west, to coordinate all armies.

literal: Day jichou: Xiao Yan's generals again took Yangshi and Huoqiu fortresses.
idiomatic: On the jichou day Xiao Yan's generals again took Yangshi and Huoqiu fortresses.

literal: Sixth month, day xinchou: they again took Xiaoxian garrison.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinchou day, they again took Xiaoxian garrison.

literal: Day yisi: Acting General Who Pacifies the West Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, beheaded five bandit chiefs including Wang Fazhi, and exposed six thousand heads.
idiomatic: On the yisi day Yuan Li, acting general who pacifies the west, greatly defeated the Qin bandits, beheaded five bandit chiefs including Wang Fazhi, and exposed six thousand heads.

literal: Day dingwei: Acting General Who Pacifies the South Xi Kangsheng defeated Xiao Yan's general Zhang Huishao and beheaded his Inspector of Xuzhou Song Hei.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day Xi Kangsheng, acting general who pacifies the south, defeated Zhang Huishao, Xiao Yan's general, and beheaded Song Hei, inspector of Xuzhou.

literal: Day dingsi: an edict ordered Master of Writing Xing Luan to go out and punish Xu and Yan.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict ordered Xing Luan, master of writing, to go out and punish Xu and Yan.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingyin: Xiao Yan's general Huan He raided Gushan and took Gucheng.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingyin day, Huan He, Xiao Yan's general, raided Gushan and took Gucheng.

literal: Day gengchen: Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, and Lü Gou'er and his kings and dukes, more than thirty men, surrendered; Qin and Jing provinces were pacified.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, and Lü Gou'er and his kings and dukes, more than thirty men, surrendered; Qin and Jing provinces were pacified.

literal: Day wuzi: Prince of Zhongshan Ying greatly defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xuzhou Wang Bo'ao at Yinling, beheaded twenty-five of his generals, and took heads and captives exceeding five thousand.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, greatly defeated Wang Bo'ao, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xuzhou, at Yinling, beheaded twenty-five of his generals, and took heads and captives exceeding five thousand.

literal: Day jichou: an edict levied one hundred thousand men from Ding, Ji, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Si provinces to reinforce the southern army.
idiomatic: On the jichou day an edict levied one hundred thousand men from Ding, Ji, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Si provinces to reinforce the southern army.

literal: Eighth month, day renyin: General Who Pacifies the East Xing Luan defeated Xiao Yan's general Huan He at Gushan and took heads exceeding ten thousand.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renyin day, Xing Luan, general who pacifies the east, defeated Huan He, Xiao Yan's general, at Gushan and took heads exceeding ten thousand.

literal: General Yuan Heng separately took Gucheng and beheaded Xiao Yan's general who champions Huan Fangqing.
idiomatic: General Yuan Heng separately took Gucheng and beheaded Huan Fangqing, Xiao Yan's general who champions.

literal: Commander Bi Zuxiu separately took Mengshan and beheaded Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry Jiao Daoyi and others; bandits and those who drowned fleeing to the Yi exceeded four thousand.
idiomatic: Commander Bi Zuxiu separately took Mengshan and beheaded Jiao Daoyi, Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry, and others; bandits and those who drowned fleeing to the Yi exceeded four thousand.

literal: Yan province was pacified.
idiomatic: Yan province was pacified.

literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South, Prince of Anle Quan, to supervise the later-arriving armies going to Huainan.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict ordered Quan, general who pacifies the south and Prince of Anle, to supervise the later-arriving armies going to Huainan.

literal: Day renxu: partial amnesty in Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He provinces.
idiomatic: On the renxu day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He provinces.

literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Xing Luan greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Suyu and beheaded his great generals Lan Huigong and more than forty others.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiyou day, Xing Luan greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Suyu and beheaded his great generals Lan Huigong and more than forty others.

literal: Zhang Huishao abandoned Suyu; Xiao Min abandoned Huaiyang and fled south; pursuit beheaded tens of thousands.
idiomatic: Zhang Huishao abandoned Suyu; Xiao Min abandoned Huaiyang and fled south; pursuit beheaded tens of thousands.

literal: Xuzhou was pacified.
idiomatic: Xuzhou was pacified.

literal: Day jichou: Prince of Zhongshan Ying greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Huainan; Xiao Hong, Xiao Yan's general of the central army and Prince of Linchuan, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yan, and Inspector of Xuzhou Chang Yizhi abandoned Liangcheng and fled east along the Huai.
idiomatic: On the jichou day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Huainan; Xiao Hong, Xiao Yan's general of the central army and Prince of Linchuan, Liu Yan, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, and Chang Yizhi, inspector of Xuzhou, abandoned Liangcheng and fled east along the Huai.

literal: Pursuit halted at Matou; Xiao Yan's general who champions and garrison commander Zhu Siyuan abandoned the city and fled by night; more than forty of Yan's generals were captured and sent; soldiers beheaded and captured exceeded fifty thousand.
idiomatic: Pursuit halted at Matou; Zhu Siyuan, Xiao Yan's general who champions and garrison commander, abandoned the city and fled by night; more than forty of Yan's generals were captured and sent; soldiers beheaded and captured exceeded fifty thousand.

literal: Ying then attacked Zhongli.
idiomatic: Ying then attacked Zhongli.

literal: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Xiao Yan dispatched generals and soldiers, thirty thousand, to raid Yiyang.
idiomatic: Xiao Yan dispatched generals and soldiers, thirty thousand, to raid Yiyang.

literal: Day dingyou: at night they fled; Inspector of Yingzhou Lou Yue pursued and defeated them.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day, at night, they fled; Lou Yue, inspector of Yingzhou, pursued and defeated them.

literal: Day wushen: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wushen day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day jiwei: General Who Campaigns the Barbarians Zhao Xia greatly defeated Xiao Yan's hosts at Sangping of Tangcheng.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day Zhao Xia, general who campaigns the barbarians, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's hosts at Sangping of Tangcheng.

literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety to Princes of Jingzhao Yu, Qinghe Yi, Guangping Huai, and Runan Yue at the Shigan Hall.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety to Yu, Prince of Jingzhao, Yi, Prince of Qinghe, Huai, Prince of Guangping, and Yue, Prince of Runan, at the Shigan Hall.

literal: Day gengyin: an edict said: "In past years Longyou rose in rebellion and the whole region was not at peace.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day an edict said, "In past years Longyou rose in rebellion and the whole region was not at peace.

literal: Among them were still those who could hold out to the end without sharing in the turmoil.
idiomatic: Among them were still those who could hold out to the end without sharing in the turmoil.

literal: In a fierce wind the strong are known—truly they may be praised.
idiomatic: In a fierce wind the strong are known—truly they may be praised.

literal: The Masters of Writing shall measure and report rewards, to display sincerity and righteousness.
idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall measure and report rewards, to display sincerity and righteousness.

literal: " That month Liang province again defeated rebel Liao.
idiomatic: " That month Liang province again defeated rebel Liao.

literal: Fourth year, second month of spring, day bingwu: Tuyuhun and Dangchang each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the second month of spring, on the bingwu day, Tuyuhun and Dangchang each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day jiwei: the state of Mohe presented hardwood arrows.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day the state of Mohe presented hardwood arrows.

literal: Third month, day bingzi: the state of Diefoluo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingzi day, the state of Diefoluo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day wuxu: great flood at Zhongli.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuxu day, there was great flood at Zhongli.

literal: Prince of Zhongshan Ying was defeated and returned.
idiomatic: Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, was defeated and returned.

literal: Day renyin: Tuyuhun, Jiumoluo, Abamobaqiemole, Xiwangjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renyin day Tuyuhun, Jiumoluo, Abamobaqiemole, Xiwangjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, day jichou, new moon: an edict said: "Gaozu's virtue reached the two poles and his brightness matched sun and moon; he spread civil teaching to cherish distant peoples and tuned ritual learning to mark outstanding talent; he moved the county to the central region and made bright the heavenly capital, balancing all that dew and frost moisten, unifying Ji's divination at the Luo shore—military affairs arose together and Confucian teaching had no leisure.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, the new moon, an edict said, "Gaozu's virtue reached the two poles and his brightness matched sun and moon; he spread civil teaching to cherish distant peoples and tuned ritual learning to mark outstanding talent; he moved the county to the central region and made bright the heavenly capital, balancing all that dew and frost moisten, unifying Ji's divination at the Luo shore—military affairs arose together and Confucian teaching had no leisure.

literal: We inherit the great thread and face the imperial succession, thinking to model the sage's rule and narrate and follow the former aim.
idiomatic: We inherit the great thread and face the imperial succession, thinking to model the sage's rule and narrate and follow the former aim.

literal: Now heaven and earth are level and the realm quiet; the four corners are without affair—let the relevant offices consult former models, establish the National University, found the Grand Academy, and plant elementary schools at the four gates.
idiomatic: Now heaven and earth are level and the realm quiet; the four corners are without affair—let the relevant offices consult former models, establish the National University, found the Grand Academy, and plant elementary schools at the four gates.

literal: " Day bingwu: Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry and Administrator of Fengyi Yu Wenzisheng and seven commanderies led one another inward in submission.
idiomatic: " On the bingwu day Yu Wenzisheng, Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry and administrator of Fengyi, and seven commanderies led one another inward in submission.

literal: Day dingwei: Shelandanaluo, Shemi, Biluozhi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day Shelandanaluo, Shemi, Biluozhi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day xinmao: the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinmao day, the Khitan state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day jihai: Prince of Zhongshan Ying and Prince of Qi Bao Zhao were sentenced for the Zhongli defeat and withdrawal; both were stripped of name and made commoners.
idiomatic: On the jihai day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, and Bao Zhao, Prince of Qi, were sentenced for the Zhongli defeat and withdrawal; both were stripped of name and made commoners.

literal: Day gengzi: Kumo Xi, Dangchang, Tuyuhun, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day Kumo Xi, Dangchang, Tuyuhun, and other states sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day xinchou: the people of Dunhuang were famished; granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day the people of Dunhuang were famished; granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Ninth month, day jiwei: an edict said: "We hold the succession and receive heaven; the years approach a reign-period; we moved to correct the palace pole and years have soaked to the year's remainder.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiwei day, an edict said, "We hold the succession and receive heaven; the years approach a reign-period; we moved to correct the palace pole and years have soaked to the year's remainder.

literal: The empress dowager, a worthy and honored kinswoman, has reverently toiled long;
idiomatic: The empress dowager, a worthy and honored kinswoman, has reverently toiled long;

literal: the ranks of offices, heroic and outstanding, have service not yet rewarded.
idiomatic: the ranks of offices, heroic and outstanding, have service not yet rewarded.

literal: This is not what is called merit seen and known, reward arriving in season.
idiomatic: This is not what is called merit seen and known, reward arriving in season.

literal: Let Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, Minister of Works, be made Grand Commandant; Jia, Master of Writing and Prince of Guangyang, be made Minister of Works; all hundred offices advance one rank.
idiomatic: Let Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, minister of works, be made grand commandant; Jia, master of writing and Prince of Guangyang, be made minister of works; all hundred offices advance one rank.

literal: " Day gengshen: Chief Clerk of Xia province Cao Ming plotted rebellion and was executed.
idiomatic: " On the gengshen day Cao Ming, chief clerk of Xia province, plotted rebellion and was executed.

literal: Day jiazi: the old road through Xiegu was opened.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day the old road through Xiegu was opened.

literal: Shule, Chelaaju, South Tianzhu, Poluo, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Shule, Chelaaju, South Tianzhu, Poluo, and other states sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day bingxu: the people of Si province were famished; granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day the people of Si province were famished; granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Intercalary month, day jiawu: the Great Sima Gate was forbidden to chariots and horses passing in or out.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the intercalary month the Great Sima Gate was forbidden to chariots and horses passing in or out.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingsi: Goryeo, Banshe, Xiwangjin, Keliujia, Bisha, Shule, Khotan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingsi day, Goryeo, Banshe, Xiwangjin, Keliujia, Bisha, Shule, Khotan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day dingmao: Empress Yu died.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day Empress Yu died.

literal: Day wuchen: the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.
